summary: The PR addresses the issue by converting CN colors to RGBA values before setting the property cycle, which resolves the ValueError. The added reproduction script and test cases demonstrate the fix.

issues.description: The new test files do not follow the typical naming convention for test files in the project, which usually start with 'test_' and are located in the appropriate test directory.
The added test scripts lack docstrings explaining their purpose and the specific scenarios they cover.
